# Application Domain - API & Microservices Patterns

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Patterns](../../README.md) • [Application](../README.md)**

This directory contains application-level patterns for API design and microservices architecture within the **Application Domain**. These patterns focus on service design, communication, data handling, and API contracts that enable modular, scalable application architectures.
page_texts.2:
[patterns/application/api-microservices/README.md#overview]

## Overview

API and Microservices patterns address:

- **Service Design**: Service boundaries, communication patterns, and API contracts
- **Data Management**: Data consistency, caching, and partitioning strategies
- **Communication**: Synchronous and asynchronous service interactions
- **Resilience**: Circuit breakers, bulkheads, and retry patterns
- **Developer Experience**: Documentation, testing, and development workflows
